reuse.why: Replaces the three copied category queries (and setZero's unfiltered one) with one getBulkBudgetCategories helper, but copyPreviousMonth does not use it.

duplication.why: Removes three duplicated queries; the exclusion rule is still expressed a second time as row checks in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Selection helper sits in server/budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it.

scope.why: Focused on the month-wide actions; only a cosmetic reflow of the Pick type is extra.

maintainability.why: A named selection helper is easy to own; the parallel rule in copyPreviousMonth (and the loose goal_def?: unknown typing, no tests) is the weak spot.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth keeps deciding hidden/group-hidden/goal_def inline over getBudgetData rows instead of selecting via getBulkBudgetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's hidden || group_hidden and goal_def != null checks restate getBulkBudgetCategories' WHERE clause in JS form.

one_place.where: The rule lives in getBulkBudgetCategories for setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg, and separately in copyPreviousMonth's own conditions.
